title: (RHBA-2021:5201) ACS 3.67.2 Bug Fix Update
portal_summary:
Updated images are now available for Red Hat Advanced Cluster Security for
Kubernetes (RHACS).
portal_product_filter: Red Hat Advanced Cluster Security for Kubernetes|Red Hat Advanced Cluster Security for Kubernetes|3|x86_64
portal_solution: To take advantage of these new features and fixes, please upgrade Red Hat Advanced Cluster Security for Kubernetes to version 3.67.2
portal_description:
The release of RHACS 3.67 provides the following new features and bug fixes:

Log4Shell policy

1. RHACS 3.67.2 includes a new policy called Log4Shell: CVE-2021-44228 - log4j Remote Code Execution vulnerability which creates alerts for deployments that have images containing the Log4Shell vulnerability (CVE-2021-44228).

Bug Fixes

1. Before this update, when integrating with Microsoft Teams, the RHACS user interface field validation did not pass certain Microsoft Teams webhook addresses. This issue has been fixed.

2. In RHACS 3.67.0, the roxctl image check command would retry on policy failures that broke builds. This issue has been fixed.

3. In RHACS 3.67.0, when using OpenShift OAuth, users' e-mails were displayed incorrectly as their username if an e-mail was unavailable. This issue has been fixed.
